adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, the code blindly dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` (new file `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`), which will raise if `:embeddable_host` is missing or not a hash. Additionally, `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!(...)` without a nil guard (`app/models/embeddable_host.rb`), so a nil `host` value would raise `NoMethodError` before validation errors can be returned. Both cases would produce a 500 instead of a 422-style validation response on malformed/absent params.
